defective_pattern: Writing regression ANOVA row labels with redundant variable repetitions and prefixes like 'رگرسیون (نام متغیر)', 'باقیمانده (نام متغیر)', 'کل (نام متغیر)'.
why_defective: Clutters APA 7 tables with repetitive parenthetical text, increases visual noise, and deviates from clean graduate thesis tabular formatting standards.
corrective_remedy: Label the regression row directly with the criterion variable name (e.g. 'رفتارهای خودآسیبی'), followed cleanly by 'باقیمانده' and 'کل'.

detection_heuristic.trigger_rule: Detection of regex pattern /رگرسیون \([^)]+\)|باقی[‌]?مانده \([^)]+\)|کل \([^)]+\)/ in table rows.
